The '''Sturgeon''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught in the [[The Mountain|mountain lake]] during [[Summer]] and [[Winter]]. It is least common during [[Weather|rainy]] winter days (only possible by using a [[Rain Totem]]) and most common on rainy summer days, comprising from 11% to 16% of all items caught. It is most likely to be caught when casting at least 3 tiles from shore.<ref name="spawnrate" /> It can also be caught during [[Summer]] and [[Winter]] on the [[Farm Maps|Wilderness Farm]]. It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] cat with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]]. It may also randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Wednesday|Wednesdays]] for {{Price|200}}, or at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|200}}.

Sturgeon can be caught regardless of time of day or season using [[Magic Bait]].

==Tailoring==
Sturgeon can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Fishing Vest]].  [[File:Shirt157.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a blue dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Fish Pond==
Sturgeon can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every 4 days. The initial pond capacity is 1 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing four quests. The only possible output is Sturgeon [[Roe]], which can be put into a [[Preserves Jar]] to make [[Caviar]].
